input.title: Monthly tax prep
input.prompt: Prepare my tax records for the previous month. Sort income and expenses into categories (income, deductible expenses by category, not deductible), total each, and list anything without a receipt or that is unclear. If earlier months' results exist, compare with them. Any amount to set aside is an estimate from these figures only: label it as an estimate and say what it assumes. If part of this is work for one of my projects, route that part to it with studio_project_route instead of doing it here.
